Name: Tuxedo Kitty
Author: nishfishh
Description:
I have no idea how to code (or if its even necessary for a mod like this) so all I can do is replace a previously existing asset with another, instead of adding an entirely new one. If you want to replace your existing cat with the tuxedo one, you'll have to figure out which cat yours is within the files. In the case you've chosen the black cat, great! You dont have to do anything. But if you've chosen any other cat, you'll have to figure out which number it is (i.e. the black cat is "cat4" in the files), go into the mod's content file and edit the target to whichever cat you have.

...Orrrr.... you can just go to the wizard and change your cat that way. forgot that was a thing.

Manifest.Name: Tuxedo Cat
Manifest.Description: Replaces the black cat asset with a tuxedo one.
Manifest.Author: nishfishh
